name: nanos world - Latest
author: YuketsuSh@users.noreply.github.com
description: Open-source Pelican egg for nanos world Dedicated Server. Direct startup (no generated wrapper), SteamCMD installation, public/bleeding-edge branches, game/query allocations and documented nanos world a1.156.0 CLI settings.
startup: bash -c 'set -e; cd /home/container; test -f ./NanosWorldServer.sh || { echo "[FATAL] NanosWorldServer.sh missing. Reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; chmod +x ./NanosWorldServer.sh; ARGS=(--name "$SERVER_NAME" --description "$SERVER_DESCRIPTION" --ip 0.0.0.0 --port "$SERVER_PORT" --query_port "$QUERY_PORT" --announce "$ANNOUNCE" --steam_app "$STEAM_APP" --map "$SERVER_MAP" --max_players "$MAX_PLAYERS" --dedicated_server "$DEDICATED_SERVER" --async_log "$ASYNC_LOG" --log_level "$LOG_LEVEL" --compression "$COMPRESSION" --max_tick_rate "$MAX_TICK_RATE" --max_sync_rate "$MAX_SYNC_RATE" --max_send_rate "$MAX_SEND_RATE" --max_file_transfer_rate "$MAX_FILE_TRANSFER_RATE" --distance_optimization "$DISTANCE_OPTIMIZATION" --thread_pool_count "$THREAD_POOL_COUNT"); [[ -n "$SERVER_PASSWORD" ]] && ARGS+=(--password "$SERVER_PASSWORD"); [[ -n "$SERVER_TOKEN" ]] && ARGS+=(--token "$SERVER_TOKEN"); [[ -n "$GAME_MODE" ]] && ARGS+=(--game_mode "$GAME_MODE"); [[ -n "$PACKAGES" ]] && ARGS+=(--packages "$PACKAGES"); [[ -n "$ASSETS" ]] && ARGS+=(--assets "$ASSETS"); [[ -n "$LOADING_SCREEN" ]] && ARGS+=(--loading_screen "$LOADING_SCREEN"); [[ -n "$SERVER_LOGO" ]] && ARGS+=(--logo "$SERVER_LOGO"); [[ -n "$CUSTOM_SETTINGS" ]] && ARGS+=(--custom_settings "$CUSTOM_SETTINGS"); [[ "$AUTO_DOWNLOAD" == "1" ]] && ARGS+=(--auto_download); [[ "$PROFILING" == "1" ]] && ARGS+=(--profiling); [[ "$LOG_SHOW_THREAD" == "1" ]] && ARGS+=(--log_show_thread); [[ "$USE_VAULT_ASSETS_LEAN" == "1" ]] && ARGS+=(--use_vault_assets_lean); [[ "$ENABLE_UNSAFE_LIBS" == "1" ]] && ARGS+=(--enable_unsafe_libs); echo "Starting nanos world on ${SERVER_PORT} TCP/UDP; query ${QUERY_PORT} UDP"; exec ./NanosWorldServer.sh "${ARGS[@]}"'

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

APP_ID="${SRCDS_APPID:-1936830}"
BRANCH="${SRCDS_BETAID:-public}"
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"
STEAMCMD_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR}/steamcmd"

mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}" "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
cd /tmp

echo "[1/3] Installing SteamCMD..."
curl -fsSL "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" -o steamcmd.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

export HOME="${INSTALL_DIR}"

echo "[2/3] Installing/verifying nanos world Dedicated Server..."
cd "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
if [[ "${BRANCH}" == "public" ]]; then
    ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "${INSTALL_DIR}" +login anonymous +app_update "${APP_ID}" validate +quit
else
    ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "${INSTALL_DIR}" +login anonymous +app_update "${APP_ID}" -beta "${BRANCH}" validate +quit
fi

echo "[3/3] Preparing runtime..."
mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64"
[[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" ]] && cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
[[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" ]] && cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

if [[ ! -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh" ]]; then
    echo "[FATAL] SteamCMD completed but NanosWorldServer.sh was not installed."
    find "${INSTALL_DIR}" -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | head -100
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh"
[[ -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer" ]] && chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer"
[[ -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServerTracy" ]] && chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServerTracy"

echo "Installation complete: ${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh is present."
exit 0

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Official nanos world Dedicated Server Steam App ID.

variables.name: Release Branch
variables.description: Steam branch to install: public or bleeding-edge.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: UDP query allocation. Must differ from the primary SERVER_PORT.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name displayed in the nanos world server list.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Description displayed in the server list (max 200 characters).
variables.default_value: A nanos world server hosted with Pelican.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional join password.

variables.name: Server Token
variables.description: Optional authorization token for Vault downloads.

variables.name: Steam App
variables.description: Players must use the same nanos world Steam App.

variables.name: Announce Server
variables.description: 1 announces the server; 0 keeps it direct-connect only.

variables.name: Dedicated Server
variables.description: 1 dedicated networking; 0 Steam Datagram Relay/P2P.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map package loaded at startup.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Optional game-mode package.

variables.name: Packages
variables.description: Optional comma-separated package list.

variables.name: Assets
variables.description: Optional comma-separated Asset Pack list.

variables.name: Loading Screen
variables.description: Optional loading-screen package.

variables.name: Server Logo
variables.description: Optional HTTP(S) JPG image URL.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous players (1-999).

variables.name: Auto Download
variables.description: Automatically download missing Vault packages/assets.

variables.name: Async Logging
variables.description: 1 enables asynchronous logging.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: 1 normal, 2 debug, 3 verbose.

variables.name: Compression
variables.description: Network compression level 0-9; upstream default is 1.

variables.name: Max Tick Rate
variables.description: Server tick rate in Hz (15-120). Upstream recommends 30.

variables.name: Max Sync Rate
variables.description: Actor synchronization rate in Hz (1-30).

variables.name: Max Send Rate
variables.description: Maximum send rate per client in KB/s (128-16384).

variables.name: Max File Transfer Rate
variables.description: Maximum package/asset transfer rate per client in KB/s. Keep <= Max Send Rate.

variables.name: Distance Optimization
variables.description: 0 disabled, 4 balanced/default, 9 most aggressive.

variables.name: Thread Pool Count
variables.description: Threads for async operations; 0 disables the pool.

variables.name: Custom Settings
variables.description: Optional TOML-style custom settings.

variables.name: Performance Profiling
variables.description: Enable profiling logs.

variables.name: Show Log Thread
variables.description: Show current thread in log output.

variables.name: Vault Lean Assets
variables.description: Only download Asset Pack TOML configs from Vault.

variables.name: Unsafe Lua Libraries
variables.description: DANGEROUS: enables unsafe Lua OS/file APIs.
